comparisons.interpretation: descriptive, validation-selected, exploratory; no statistical significance or causal claim

protocol.origin: exploratory follow-up to already observed main results
protocol.paired_rule: same seed: one pretrained base and identical fresh finetune generator per cell
comparisons: PiSSA minus fc_full validation loss per seed at each lr/checkpoint
PiSSA minus LoRA and fixed-lr fc_full reference per seed at each rank/checkpoint
count negative paired differences; report complete cells, not only winners
adjacent changes of mean signed gap as lr/rank increases
protocol.best_lr_rule: per method minimize across-seed mean final validation loss; ties use smaller lr
protocol.best_lr_reporting: use that single selected lr for every seed; report paired gaps at both checkpoints
protocol.interpretation: same-lr and method-specific validation-selected best-lr comparisons answer different questions; selected validation scores are not independent test estimates
protocol.causal_limit: gap changes and effective-FC displacements identify candidate explanations, not proven mechanisms
protocol.rank_limit: full-rank adapters still have different parameterization/count from dense FC; no inference about paper Fig.2(a)
